scope: Puri coastal food guide and notebook
Founder byline, visible source notes and natural reading rhythm
reader_gain: The offering, attributed ritual history and GI registration are explained separately. Readers can trace each to its evidence without repeated bibliography in the prose.

checks.desktop: 1280x900 opening, 740px reading column and visible notes inspected.
checks.mobile: 390x844 opening, full-frame photograph, reading and source notes inspected; no horizontal overflow.
checks.keyboard: Enter on a narrative marker focuses the exact note; return to notebook-stop-0 opens the folded details and focuses the exact original marker.
checks.media: Existing documentary photo visually inspected and unchanged; photographer and CC BY-SA licence retained.
checks.scope: Other notebook records asserted unchanged; only Puri enables RegionalMeal editorial mode.

limitations: Same-assistant review, not independent human or specialist approval.
Responsive emulation, not physical-device or screen-reader testing.
No field visit, cook interview, tasting, kitchen inspection or access confirmation.
Editorial revision does not increase substantive500.
